name: fundraising-economics
skills: The economics of community fundraising, from the Fenwick benchmark of 212 raffles in housing estates and villages: how many households take part at each ticket price, tickets per household, sales per draw and per year, typical costs, prize plans that sell, seasonality, matching by local businesses, how a raffle compares with an appeal or a levy.
examples: How much will a monthly raffle raise in an estate of 800 households?
Which ticket price brings in the most money?
Is a raffle or a one-off appeal better for a 30,000 EUR project?
